title: Tabulation configuration circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine, let $n,T$ be nonnegative integers, and let $z$ be a finite Boolean word. Define the tabulation configuration circuit on $n$ input bits by applying the tabulation-circuit construction with the parameters derived from $M$, with input width $|z|+n$, the input-bit layout of that width, step budget $T$, and the snapshot index and width specified by the machine-dependent snapshot functions at $T$.
caveat: The supplied statement omits the meanings of the tabulation-circuit construction and the machine-dependent arity, width, transition, program, and snapshot functions.
